messages:
ravi: Hey team — planning a small rollout for the new kv-prefetch + microbatch coalesce logic. Intend to flip ff.kv_coalesce_v2 from 0 -> 5% traffic at 09:30 UTC and validate for 30m. Will expand to 25% if metrics look good. 

maria: Thanks — quick asks: what are our explicit rollback gates? and who's owning the first 30m watch?

sam: I can watch metrics for the first 30m. Rollback gates I'd set: p95 tail latency > +15% vs baseline OR error-rate spike +1% absolute OR cache hit-rate drop > 10% absolute. If any of those trigger, we revert back to 0% immediately.

leo: Also add GPU token QPS and kv-store latency (median) checks. Past runs showed kv latency jitter causes tail latency. I'd add a K8s pod churning check too.

anna: Thanks — can we put an automated rollback script in the deploy playbook? Something like: 
```
# automated revert CLI
redwood-ctl flags set ff.kv_coalesce_v2 0 --scope global --by-operator rollout-rollback
```
and an oncall patch that runs if alert condition persists for 2 consecutive minutes.

ravi: Good call. I'll add the CLI step and a short runbook note. Also planning to set a soft-snooze on low-priority perf alerts to avoid noise during steady-state ramp: /snooze perf-alerts 30m — but not for p95 or error logs.

oncall-bot: [ALERT CONFIG] Perf dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/kvcache-coalesce
- Alert rules bound to rollout: kv_coalesce_latency_regress (p95 > 15% for 2m), kv_error_rate_increase (delta > 1% for 1m)
- Auto-revert: disabled by default; manual revert recommended unless oncall approves.

maria: Can we enable auto-revert for the initial 5% canary only? That would keep things fast if we get a clear regression. Manual for later stages.

sam: I'm +1 for auto-revert at 5% if we can implement a safe revert window (1-2m confirmation) to avoid flapping. I can build the confirmation step in the deploy script.

ravi: I'll push a tiny deploy helper in the canary job: confirm_alerts() waits 60s to make sure alerts are persistent before reverting. If confirmed, it flips ff.kv_coalesce_v2 back to 0 and pings #eng-oncall.

leo: Audience selection: use traffic slicing by customer_tier to avoid hitting enterprise customers during 5%. Use rollout audience: random sample of dev/devices + non-enterprise. Otherwise hit rate map looks noisy.

anna: Code review ping: @maria @sam please review the rollout helper PR when ready; I'll sign off infra changes. Trying to keep this low-risk. :thumbsup:

maria: Will review. Also can we add a quick synthetic test that runs 100 short inference requests through the canary path every minute? It can help detect semantic regressions in caching logic (wrong keys).

ravi: Yes — adding synthetic check that verifies prefix hit rate and output token count distribution. If the synthetic fails, trigger immediate rollback.

sam: I'll be on hand during 09:15-10:30 UTC. Ping me in thread when we flip.

ravi: Flipping plan finalized: 09:30 UTC -> 5% (auto-revert enabled with 60s confirmation), 30m watch, synthetic + metrics + manual ops. Rollout expansion to 25% requires signoff from anna + sam.

anna: Acknowledged. Good plan. :rocket:

oncall-bot: NOTE: This thread has been pinned to #eng-oncall for the rollout window.
